modifier.castingtools.excavation.descrip: Increases the area of effect when mining, allowing you to mine multiple blocks at once
modifier.castingtools.fortune.descriptio: Increases the chance of receiving more items when mining certain block, like Ores
modifier.castingtools.ignite.description: Sets mobs on fire when hit
modifier.castingtools.sharpness.descript: Increases the damage dealt to mobs
modifier.castingtools.silk_touch.descrip: Allows you to mine blocks and receive the block itself instead of its usual drops, such as mining stone and receiving a stone block instead of cobblestone
